promotion.iclr_arm: this manifest's ICLR dev papers (192); do not redraw
promotion.note: The ICLR promotion arm is this dev list. The private confirmation set is the HMAC holdout (24 papers). rank_eval defaults to the dev list. Status is locked. Grok scores the full dev set and the holdout. Opus validation uses opus_validation.

selection.parent_pool: Public OpenReview ICLR 2024 and ICLR 2025 listings (14301 submissions with an accept or reject decision: 5690 from 2024, 8611 from 2025). Eligible papers have at least two official ratings. The rated pool is 876 papers. The previous 48 dev papers stay in the dev set. The previous 12-paper holdout is in the dev set and is excluded from the new holdout.
selection.rule: Keep the previous dev papers. Place the previous holdout papers in the dev set. Inside a tier, sort the remaining forum ids and shuffle with Random(f'fixed-eval-v1:20261101:{tier}'). Take at most 16 papers from one primary area and at most 30 papers from one year, then relax a cap only if the dev quota is short. The private holdout is the next 6 papers in that order, with at most 4 from one year, and it does not reuse a dev paper or a previous holdout paper.

cache.baseline: Run the baseline arm once on the standing slice and reuse it.
cache.candidate: Each validation runs only the candidate arm on the standing slice.
cache.cold_start: If both arms must run in that validation, use the cold-start prefix.

opus_validation.ordering: Inside each tier, sort forum ids and shuffle with Random(f'opus-validation:{seed}:{tier}'). paper_ids_by_tier keeps that shuffle order. The standing slice is the first papers_per_tier ids. The cold start, when both arms must run in one validation, is the first cold_start_per_tier ids of the same list.
